title: YieldCraft AI
tagline: An AI-powered cross-chain DeFi yield optimizer for all your assets
description:
YieldCraft AI is a revolutionary cross-chain DeFi yield aggregator that leverages artificial intelligence to automatically optimize yield farming strategies across Hedera and Rootstock networks. The platform addresses the complexity of navigating volatile crypto yields by using advanced AI algorithms to analyze market data, identify optimal opportunities, and execute automated investment strategies.

Key Features:

🤖 Intelligent AI Agent: Built with Hedron Agent Kit and Model Context Protocol (MCP), our AI agent continuously monitors SaucerSwap, Bonzo Finance on Hedera, and SushiSwap on Rootstock. It provides personalized yield recommendations based on real-time market analysis of TVL, liquidity, and volatility patterns.

⛓️ Cross-Chain Optimization: Using LayerZero protocol for seamless cross-chain asset bridging, users can access the best yield opportunities across both Hedera (HBAR/USDC) and Rootstock (WRBTC/RUSDT) ecosystems without manual chain switching.

🏦 Advanced Vault Strategies: Our SushiSwap vault strategy implements:

Dynamic liquidity rebalancing every 6 hours using moveticks function
Dual positioning: main liquidity provision + single-sided limit orders
Automated rewards harvesting and compounding
Currently achieving 20.34% APR on WBTC/USDT pools
📊 Real-Time Intelligence: Integration with Pyth Network provides accurate price feeds for optimal entry/exit timing and risk assessment, while the conversational AI interface allows natural language queries about portfolio performance and strategy adjustments.

💡 Personalized Risk Management: The AI analyzes user risk tolerance and automatically calculates impermanent loss scenarios, providing tailored investment strategies that align with individual goals and risk profiles.

how_its_made:
Built  Cross-Chain AI agents using Hedera Agent Kit on Hedera  and Rootstock   with Hedera's  MCP protocol for blockchain communication. Rootstock hosts automated  ERC 4626 vault contracts for  managing SushiSwap liquidity positions with 6-hour rebalancing cycles. Pyth Network provides real-time price feeds for yield calculations.

The frontend communicates via WebSocket to Hedera AI agent, which analyzes market data and executes cross-chain strategies using LayerZero bridges. Smart contracts written in Solidity (Rootstock vaults) and integrated with Hedera Token Service for Interacting with ERC20 based tokens on hedera.
Created a novel "conversational yield farming" interface where users chat with AI to get executable strategies. The agent autonomously calculates optimal tick ranges, manages impermanent loss, and auto-compounds rewards across chains—essentially an AI portfolio manager that never sleeps.
